cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(KRdp VERSION 6.7.5 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_INCLUDE_CURRENT_DIR ON)
find_package(ECM REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${ECM_MODULE_PATH})
include(ECMQtDeclareLoggingCategory)
include(ECMGenerateExportHeader)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Network DBus WaylandClient Qml)
find_package(KF6CoreAddons REQUIRED)
find_package(KF6GuiAddons REQUIRED)
find_package(KF6Config REQUIRED)
set(KRDP_DEPS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Optional root containing unpacked Fedora development RPMs")
set(S "${KRDP_DEPS_ROOT}/usr")
add_library(KRdp SHARED)
file(GLOB sources src/*.cpp)
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "krdp_logging")
target_sources(KRdp PRIVATE ${sources})
target_include_directories(KRdp PRIVATE src ${S}/include ${S}/include/freerdp3 ${S}/include/winpr3 ${S}/include/KPipeWire ${S}/include/pipewire-0.3 ${S}/include/spa-0.2 ${S}/include/libdrm ${S}/include/qt6/QtGui/${Qt6Gui_VERSION} ${S}/include/qt6/QtGui/${Qt6Gui_VERSION}/QtGui /usr/include/qt6/QtGui/${Qt6Gui_VERSION} /usr/include/qt6/QtGui/${Qt6Gui_VERSION}/QtGui)
target_link_libraries(KRdp PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Network Qt6::DBus Qt6::WaylandClient Qt6::Qml KF6::CoreAddons KF6::GuiAddons KF6::ConfigCore /usr/lib64/libfreerdp3.so.3 /usr/lib64/libfreerdp-server3.so.3 /usr/lib64/libwinpr3.so.3 /usr/lib64/libKPipeWire.so.6 /usr/lib64/libKPipeWireRecord.so.6 /usr/lib64/libKPipeWireDmaBuf.so.6 /usr/lib64/libxkbcommon.so.0 /usr/lib64/libpam.so.0)
ecm_qt_declare_logging_category(KRdp HEADER krdp_logging.h IDENTIFIER KRDP CATEGORY_NAME org.kde.krdp)
ecm_generate_export_header(KRdp BASE_NAME KRdp VERSION 6.7.5 DEPRECATED_BASE_VERSION 0)
qt6_add_dbus_interface(dbus_sources src/xdp_dbus_remotedesktop_interface.xml xdp_dbus_remotedesktop_interface)
qt6_add_dbus_interface(dbus_sources src/xdp_dbus_screencast_interface.xml xdp_dbus_screencast_interface)
target_sources(KRdp PRIVATE ${dbus_sources})
qt6_generate_wayland_protocol_client_sources(KRdp PRIVATE_CODE FILES ${S}/share/plasma-wayland-protocols/zkde-screencast-unstable-v1.xml ${S}/share/plasma-wayland-protocols/fake-input.xml /usr/share/wayland/wayland.xml)
set_target_properties(KRdp PROPERTIES VERSION 6.7.5 SOVERSION 6)

option(BUILD_FIX_TESTS "Build regression tests for the local fixes" ON)
if(BUILD_FIX_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_executable(test-frame-ack local-tests/test-frame-ack.cpp)
    target_include_directories(test-frame-ack PRIVATE src)
    target_link_libraries(test-frame-ack PRIVATE Qt6::Core)
    target_compile_options(test-frame-ack PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    add_test(NAME frame-acknowledgement COMMAND test-frame-ack)
    add_executable(test-progressive-geometry local-tests/test-progressive-geometry.cpp)
    target_include_directories(test-progressive-geometry PRIVATE ${S}/include/freerdp3 ${S}/include/winpr3)
    target_link_libraries(test-progressive-geometry PRIVATE Qt6::Gui /usr/lib64/libfreerdp3.so.3 /usr/lib64/libwinpr3.so.3)
    target_compile_options(test-progressive-geometry PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    add_test(NAME progressive-geometry COMMAND test-progressive-geometry)
endif()
